title: ResponseLogRow
description: ONE participant response = ONE row. Produced by the experiment runtime (Unity), consumed by the Cloudflare Worker (POST /responses), local CSV export, and analysis. Canonical CSV column order is defined in spec/RESPONSE_LOG.md and MUST match the required+optional field order here.

study_id.description: The study this row belongs to (study.schema.json).

pair_id.description: The control/treatment pair shown (experiment.pair_id in the RoomSpecs).

participant_id.description: Anonymous participant identifier (assigned by the runner, never PII).

session_id.description: One sitting = one session (UUID). Distinguishes re-runs by the same participant.

trial_index.description: 0-based position of this trial within the session's presentation order.

task_type.description: v1 task registry: 'rating' (single-stimulus scale rating) or 'choice' (A-vs-B paired comparison). Extending this enum is a contract change (COORDINATION.md rule).

condition.description: Which condition the participant responded to. 'both' for A-vs-B choice trials that present the pair together.

manipulated_variables.description: Copied verbatim from the pair's experiment.manipulated_variables — every row is self-describing for analysis.

modality.description: How the room was experienced. Guardrail #3: modality is a recorded variable — NEVER pool rows across modalities. 3D-only project: there is deliberately no 2D/image modality.

execution_path.description: Honesty label of the stimulus the participant actually saw (project convention).

scale_min.description: Lowest point on the rating scale (e.g. 1).

scale_max.description: Highest point on the rating scale (e.g. 7).

value.description: The participant's rating. MUST lie within [scale_min, scale_max] — runner-enforced.

prompt.description: The question wording shown, for the record.

left_condition.description: Condition shown on the left (side assignment is counterbalanced via the seed).

rt_ms.description: Response time in milliseconds (stimulus onset -> response). OPTIONAL: rating/choice tasks are accuracy-first; native desktop timing is trustworthy, but treat any future browser arm's RT as approximate (~80-100 ms platform lag, PROPOSAL.md section 4).

timestamp_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC time the response was recorded.

presentation_order_seed.description: Seed of the deterministic shuffle that produced this session's trial order (determinism guardrail: seed + trial_index fully reconstructs what was shown when).

runner_version.description: Version of the experiment runtime that produced this row (provenance).

spec_sha256.description: OPTIONAL content hash of the exact RoomSpec shown (STORAGE.md content-addressing) — pins the row to an immutable stimulus.
